sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Amanulla Usmani - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Aatamaram Ben - Government Advocate for the responden

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant Bhupendra Kahar under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 28.06.2024 in connection with Crime No.382 of 2024 registered at P.S. Sohagpur, District-Narmadapuram for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(n),
376(3) and 506 of IPC, under Section 5/6 of POCSO Act and under Sections 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of SC/ST (POA) Act.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrated sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after investigation, charge-sheet has been filed and Applicant is in jail since 28.06.2024.
It is also urged that prosecutrix and her mother have been examined and they have turned hostile and did not support the prosecution story.
Further, no injuries have been found on the person of prosecutrix.

Further, after referring NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60916 2 MCRC-50763-2024 to prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 183 of the BNS, it is urged that it is a case of consensual relationship.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
